---
title: "Alchemer account archive"
format:
  html:
    embed-resources: true
params:
  archive_dir: "alchemer_archive"
  min_age: 600
  refresh: "auto"
---

Keeps one `survey_<id>.rds` file per survey of the account in `archive_dir`,
with test data included, and lists what happened. Only read-only requests are
sent. Credentials: set `ALCHEMER_API_TOKEN` and `ALCHEMER_API_SECRET`
(for example from `keyring` in your `.Renviron` or at the top of this file).
Copy this file with
`file.copy(system.file("quarto", "Archive_account.qmd", package = "alchemeR"), ".")`.

```{r}
#| label: archive
library(alchemeR)
dir <- params$archive_dir
dir.create(dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

surveys <- all_surveys()
saveRDS(surveys, file.path(dir, "surveys.rds")) # the account list at run time

one <- function(id) {
  tryCatch(
    {
      rows <- nrow(fetch_survey(id, dir = dir, refresh = params$refresh,
                                min_age = params$min_age, include_test = TRUE))
      data.frame(id = id, rows = rows, error = NA_character_)
    },
    error = \(e) data.frame(id = id, rows = NA_integer_, error = conditionMessage(e))
  )
}
result <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(surveys$id, one))

files <- file.path(dir, paste0("survey_", result$id, ".rds"))
overview <- dplyr::tibble(
  id = result$id, title = surveys$title, status = surveys$status,
  rows = result$rows, size_mb = round(file.size(files) / 1e6, 2),
  file_updated = file.mtime(files), error = result$error
)
orphans <- setdiff(
  sub("^survey_(\\d+)\\.rds$", "\\1", list.files(dir, "^survey_\\d+\\.rds$")),
  as.character(surveys$id)
)
```

## Failures

```{r}
#| echo: false
failed <- overview[!is.na(overview$error), c("id", "title", "error")]
if (nrow(failed) > 0) knitr::kable(failed) else cat("None.")
```

## All surveys

```{r}
#| echo: false
knitr::kable(overview[order(overview$id), names(overview) != "error"])
```

`r nrow(overview)` surveys, `r format(sum(overview$rows, na.rm = TRUE), big.mark = ",")` responses,
`r round(sum(overview$size_mb, na.rm = TRUE), 1)` MB.

## Files for surveys no longer on the account

```{r}
#| echo: false
if (length(orphans) > 0) cat(paste0("survey_", orphans, ".rds"), sep = "\n") else cat("None.")
```
